import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; c=set()
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); c.add((y,x))
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        for dx in(-1,0,1):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]!=bg and not seen[ny][nx]:
                                seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(c)
    return out
def variants(cells):
    ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
    mi=(min(ys),min(xs)); mx=(max(ys),max(xs))
    h=mx[0]-mi[0]+1; w=mx[1]-mi[1]+1
    rel=[(y-mi[0],x-mi[1]) for y,x in cells]
    V=frozenset(rel)
    flip_h=frozenset((y,w-1-x) for y,x in rel)   # mirror horizontally within bbox
    flip_v=frozenset((h-1-y,x) for y,x in rel)
    rot=frozenset((x,y) for y,x in rel)           # transpose
    return [V,flip_h,flip_v,rot,flip_h^flip_v]  # placeholder
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rare=min([c for c in cnt if c!=bg],key=lambda z:cnt[z])
    cs=comps(g,bg)
    canvas=[[bg]*0 for _ in range(H)]
    objs=[]
    for c in cs:
        # only keep non-noise cells
        cells=[p for p in c if g[p[0]][p[1]]!=rare]
        if not cells: continue
        ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
        mi=(min(ys),min(xs)); mx=(max(ys),max(xs))
        h=mx[0]-mi[0]+1; w=mx[1]-mi[1]+1
        obj=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for y,x in cells: obj[y-mi[0]][x-mi[1]]=g[y][x]
        objs.append(obj)
    # align all objects to top-left, stack left-to-right sorted by topmost row? try sorted by min col originally
    objs.sort(key=lambda o: min(p[1] for p in [(i*(len(o[0])+1)+j) for i in range(len(o)) for j in range(len(o[0])) if o[i][j]!=bg]))
    total=sum(len(o) and len(o[0]) for o in objs)
    res=[[bg]*total for _ in range(max(len(o) for o in objs))]
    x=0
    for o in objs:
        for i in range(len(o)):
            for j in range(len(o[0])):
                if o[i][j]!=bg: res[i][x+j]=o[i][j]
        x+=len(o[0])
    return res
for n in (3,4):
    pred=solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); exp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n, pred==exp)

                newH=max(bbox_h, max(r for r,c in rem|t)-min(r for r,c in rem|t)+1) if False else None
                u=rem|t

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    g=[list(r) for r in g]
    moved=True
    while moved:
        moved=False
        new=[row[:] for row in g]
        for r in range(h-1,-1,-1):
            for c in range(w):
                v=g[r][c]
                if v!=bg:
                    nr,nc=r+1,c-1
                    if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and g[nr][nc]==bg:
                        new[nr][nc]=v
                        new[r][c]=bg
                        moved=True
        g=new
    # crop trailing empty columns, keep full height
    w2=w-1
    while w2>0 and all(g[r][w2]==bg for r in range(h)): w2-=1
    return [row[:w2+1] for row in g]

def try_rule(g, key):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_of(g,bg)
    objs=[{'c':c,'cells':set(cl)} for c,cl in cs if len(cl)>1]
    singles=[p for c,cl in cs if len(cl)==1 for p in cl]
    for p in singles:
        cands=[o for o in objs if any((p[0]+d,p[1]+dd) in o['cells'] for d,dd in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)))]
        if cands: host=min(cands,key=lambda o:min(abs(p[0]-y)+abs(p[1]-x) for y,x in o['cells']))
        else:
            host=min(objs,key=lambda o:min(abs(p[0]-y)+abs(p[1]-x) for y,x in o['cells']))
        host['c']=p; host['cells'].add((p[0],p[1]))
    order=objs if key=='bottom' else sorted(objs,key=lambda o:max(r for r,_ in o['cells']))
    canvas=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    placed=[]
    for o in order:
        cur=list(o['cells'])
        cur.sort()
        floor=h-1-max(r for r,_ in cur)
        cur=[(r+floor,c) for r,c in cur]
        shift=0
        while True:
            nxt=[(r,c-shift-1) for r,c in cur]
            coll=any(not(0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w) or any((nr,nc) in s for s in placed) for nr,nc in nxt)
            if coll: break
            cur=nxt; shift+=1
        placed.append(cur)
    for i,cur in enumerate(placed):
        for r,c in cur: canvas[r][c]=order[i]['c']
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if canvas[r][c]!=bg]
    return [[canvas[r][c] for c in range(min(c for _,c in pts),max(c for _,c in pts)+1)] for r in range(min(r for r,_ in pts),max(r for r,_ in pts)+1)], (key)

for k in ['Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:
    print(k, try_rule(G[k+' input'],'bottom')[0]==G[k+' output'], try_rule(G[k+' input'],'top')[0]==G[k+' output'])

def solve(g, attach='nearest'):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_of(g,bg)
    objs=[{'c':c,'cells':set(cl)} for c,cl in cs if len(cl)>1]
    singles=[next(iter(cl)) for c,cl in cs if len(cl)==1]
    # attach singles: prefer same-color adjacency; else nearest multi obj (Manhattan)
    for p in singles:
        adj=[o for o in objs if any((p[0]+d,p[1]+dd) in o['cells'] for d,dd in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)))]
        if adj: host=min(adj,key=lambda o:min(abs(p[0]-y)+abs(p[1]-x) for y,x in o['cells']))
        else:
            host=min(objs,key=lambda o:min(abs(p[0]-y)+abs(p[1]-x) for y,x in o['cells']))
        host['cells'].add(p)
    placed=[]; occ=set()
    for o in sorted(objs,key=lambda o:max(r for r,_ in o['cells']),reverse=True):
        cur=list(o['cells'])
        # fall down until blocked
        while True:
            nxt=[(r+1,c) for r,c in cur]
            if any(not(0<=r<h) or (r,c) in occ for r,c in nxt): break
            cur=nxt
        # slide left until blocked
        while True:
            nxt=[(r,c-1) for r,c in cur]
            if any(c<0 or (r,c) in occ for r,c in nxt): break
            cur=nxt
        placed.append(cur); occ|=cur
    canvas=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for cur in placed:
        for r,c in cur: canvas[r][c]=objs[placed.index(cur)]['c']
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if canvas[r][c]!=bg]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(r for r,_ in pts),max(r for r,_ in pts),min(c for _,c in pts),max(c for _,c in pts)
    return [[canvas[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_of(g,bg)
    objs=[{'c':c,'cells':set(cl)} for c,cl in cs if len(cl)>1]
    singles=[next(iter(cl)) for c,cl in cs if len(cl)==1]
    # attach singletons: slide diagonally down-left until orthogonally adjacent to an object; take host color
    occ=set().union(*[o['cells'] for o in objs]) if objs else set()
    placed=[]
    for p in singles:
        cur=[p]; path=[]
        while True:
            nxt=[(r-1,c-1) for r,c in cur]
            if any(r<0 or c<0 or r>=h or c>=w for r,c in nxt): break
            if any((r,c) in occ for r,c in nxt): break
            cur=nxt; path.append(cur[-1])
        # attach at last cell of path; find nearest object orthogonally from there
        best=None
        for o in objs:
            d=min(abs(p[0]-y)+abs(p[1]-x) for y,x in o['cells'])
            if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,o)
        o=best[1]; o['cells'].add(path[-1] if path else p); placed.append((path[-1] if path else p,o))
    # now all objects multi-cell; slide each down-left simultaneously until blocked
    cur={i:set(o['cells']) for i,o in enumerate(objs)}
    moved=True
    while moved:
        moved=False
        for i,cells in list(cur.items()):
            can=all(0<=r-1<h and 0<=c-1<w and (r-1,c-1) not in occ for r,c in cells)
            if can:
                cur[i]=set((r-1,c-1) for r,c in cells); moved=True
        occ=set().union(*cur.values())
    canvas=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i,cells in cur.items():
        for r,c in cells: canvas[r][c]=objs[i]['c']
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if canvas[r][c]!=bg]
    return [[canvas[r][c] for c in range(min(c for _,c in pts),max(c for _,c in pts)+1)] for r in range(min(r for r,_ in pts),max(r for r,_ in pts)+1)]
